en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a large mountain lodge nestled on a steep rocky slope. The multi‑story wooden building with a metal roof sits beside a mountain path, with outdoor seating visible in front. Behind it rises a dramatic cliff face characteristic of a high‑altitude valley. At the bottom edge, there is handwritten German text describing the place and its elevation.
